message:
`createUser` now accepts an optional `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it (`null` when not set). `npm test` passes, including `test/users-nickname.test.js`.

I added the `nickname` column from application code, not as a migration, because `migrations/` is off-limits. In `src/api/users.js`, `createUser` adds the column to the users table the first time it runs if it's missing. This is a workaround, so you may want the DBA team to add a real `003` migration for `nickname`. Once they do, I can delete the `ensureNicknameColumn` helper. It only checks whether the column exists, so it won't conflict with their migration.

I didn't touch `migrations/`.
